docs.summary: A node in the imported scene hierarchy. A named transform plus optional mesh / skin references, with no components or scripts attached.
docs.remarks: Local transform is stored in TRS form. The 4x4 matrices are computed once during import. Sibling order is preserved from the source file.

members.name: Index
members.signature: public required int Index { get; init; }

docs.summary: Node name. Empty when the source did not name the node.

members.name: Parent
members.signature: public ModelNode? Parent { get; internal set; }

docs.summary: Parent node, or `null` when this is the model root.

members.name: Children
members.signature: public IReadOnlyList<ModelNode> Children { get; internal set; }

docs.summary: 4x4 TRS matrix representing this node's transform relative to its parent.
4x4 matrix from this node's local space to the model's root space, baked at import time.
Index into [`Meshes`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Model~Meshes) for the mesh attached to this node, or -1 for none.
Index into [`Skins`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Model~Skins) when this node is a `SkinnedMeshRenderer` host, otherwise -1.
Index into [`Cameras`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Model~Cameras) for the camera on this node, or -1 for none.
Index into [`Lights`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Model~Lights) for the light on this node, or -1 for none.
